title: The helicopter costume
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies (the trilogy ran in print in three papers)
logline: Friday. Halloween. A kid at the garage door in a stick-figure costume with a cardboard rotor. The dog barks once from the bed. Wood gives the kid every piece of candy in the garage, which is four. The strip is kind to it.

panels.composition: The garage door open at dusk. A KID in a costume: white sweats with black lines drawn on, a cardboard four-blade rotor on a headband. WOOD in the door. BARNABY in the bed, head up.

image.prompt: quiet ink line with water bleeding over the edges, desaturated wet-on-wet in raw umber and Payne's gray and Prussian blue, a child in a homemade stick-figure costume with a cardboard helicopter rotor on a headband standing at an open garage door at dusk, a thin man in the doorway, an old dog lifting its head from a bed

panels.composition: The dog's one bark. From the bed. At the rotor.

image.prompt: quiet ink line with water bleeding over the edges, desaturated wet-on-wet in raw umber and Payne's gray and Prussian blue, close-up of an old dog in a bed giving one bark toward a cardboard rotor, no words

panels.composition: Wood searching the garage. A drawer. Four pieces of candy, ancient. Into the kid's bag, all four.

balloons.text: That's all of it. That's everything.

image.prompt: quiet ink line with water bleeding over the edges, desaturated wet-on-wet in raw umber and Payne's gray and Prussian blue, a thin man dropping four pieces of old candy into a child's trick-or-treat bag

panels.composition: The kid running off, the rotor bobbing. Wood in the door. The dog's head back down. Wood watching the rotor go, and — the strip is honest — almost smiling.

image.prompt: quiet ink line with water bleeding over the edges, desaturated wet-on-wet in raw umber and Payne's gray and Prussian blue, a child in a rotor costume running off down an alley while a thin man in a garage doorway watches with the beginning of a smile, an old dog settling back in its bed, no words

art.line: quiet; water bleeding over the ink edge to suggest rain and fading light
art.palette: desaturated wet-on-wet: raw umber, Payne's gray, Prussian blue, raw sienna
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for the Sundays

notes: A kid dressed as the thing. Four pieces of candy. Almost a smile.
